shortDescription: Novelis Inc., the US-based aluminum producer owned by India’s Hindalco Industries Ltd., agreed to sell two wholly owned Chinese subsidiaries for about $265 million as it pares its operations in China, according to Bloomberg.

title: Novelis Agrees to Sell Two China Subsidiaries for About $265 Million
